scripts.name: example_1
scripts.src:
# Highland Passes — a family of maps, not one map.
size 128
biome alpine
seats 4
symmetry quad

base grass
blob meadow count 40 radius 2-5
blob mountain count 10 radius 4-8
blob hill count 22 radius 3-6
blob forest count 26 radius 3-6
lake water count 4 radius 4-8
river shallow width 3

# Seats first: the clusters below are placed relative to them.
spawns ring radius 0.34

cluster berries count 1 near start radius 6-10 nodes 6
cluster gold count 2 near start radius 20-40 nodes 5
cluster tree count 4 near start radius 10-18 nodes 8
scatter tree count 260

scripts.name: errors
scripts.src:
size 128
blob nonsense count 3
frobnicate
count
scatter rubies
spawn at x,y
blob rock count -2

errors.text: unknown command "frobnicate" — try size, biome, seats, symmetry, base, blob, ring, river, spawns, spawn, cluster, scatter
unknown command "count" — try size, biome, seats, symmetry, base, blob, ring, river, spawns, spawn, cluster, scatter
scatter wants a resource (tree, gold, berries), got "rubies"

unknown symmetry "sideways" — try none, mirrorX, mirrorY, rot180, quad, radial3, radial6, radial8
